sentences: Before you register your business, you need a business number (BN) from the CRA.
Most small businesses use the calendar year as their fiscal year.
Keep your accounting records for six years after the end of the fiscal year they relate to.
Keep a copy of your accounts payable and accounts receivable for each fiscal year.
You can apply for your SIN at a Service Canada office.

outputs.en: Before you register your business, you need a business number (BN) from the CRA.
outputs.fr: Avant d'enregistrer votre entreprise, vous devez obtenir un numéro d'entreprise (NE) auprès du RRCQ.

outputs.en: Most small businesses use the calendar year as their fiscal year.
outputs.fr: La plupart des petites entreprises utilisent l'année civile comme année fiscale.

outputs.en: Keep your accounting records for six years after the end of the fiscal year they relate to.
outputs.fr: Conservez vos documents comptables pendant six ans après la fin de l'exercice fiscal auquel ils se rapportent.

outputs.en: Keep a copy of your accounts payable and accounts receivable for each fiscal year.
outputs.fr: Conservez une copie de vos comptes à payer et de vos comptes à recevoir pour chaque exercice financier.

outputs.en: You can apply for your SIN at a Service Canada office.
outputs.fr: Vous pouvez demander votre numéro d'assurance sociale (NAS) à un bureau de Services Canada.
